segments.text: This is a fictional demonstration visit with fictional participants. Welcome back. Tell me what brought you in today and what you were hoping we could help with.
I have had a cough for four days. It keeps interrupting my sleep, and I wanted someone to check it before I go back to work. I brought my medicine list along.
Thanks for bringing the list. We will go through it together. Have you had any fever with this illness?
I have not had any fever during these four days. I checked at home because I wondered about that too.
Before I examine you, tell me about the conditions you already manage and any relevant illnesses in your family.
I have asthma. That is something I still manage, and the previous clinic has the older records if you need them.
My father has diabetes. He lives in another town, so we usually talk about his appointments on the phone. That part of the history is about him.
I will keep your history separate from your family history. Which medicine on that list are you continuing to use?
I still use albuterol. It is the same medicine from my previous clinic, and I brought the inhaler so you can look at the label.
That is helpful. We also need to check allergies before discussing anything new. What reactions have you had to medicines?
I am allergic to sulfa; it gave me a rash years ago. I remember being told to mention it at appointments, although I cannot remember the name on the bottle.
Thank you. What about penicillin specifically?
I am not allergic to penicillin. I want that distinction to be clear when you write the list.
Let me check your measurements while you are seated, then I will listen to your chest. Please rest your arm here.
Your blood pressure is 126 over 78 mmHg. I will put that measurement in the visit record.
Your heart rate is 84 beats per minute. Now I will finish the examination.
All right. I appreciate you taking time to explain what you are recording.
My assessment today is acute bronchitis, unspecified. That is the working assessment I am recording from this visit, and we can review it at follow-up.
I have ruled out pneumonia today. Please contact the clinic again if things change after you leave.
Can we talk through the medicine plan before I go? I want to be sure I have understood it.
Amoxicillin is something we discussed, but I am not ordering amoxicillin today. I want the visit summary to reflect that distinction.
I am starting acetaminophen, 500 mg by mouth every eight hours as needed. This is the new medicine order I am proposing at this visit.
Thank you. Having a written summary will help me remember the discussion when I get home.
We will review the medicine and allergy entries before any record is finalized. Please arrange follow-up with the front desk. That concludes this fictional demonstration visit.
